name: UROVAS
name_zh: 深圳季连科技有限公司
summary: UROVAS is the robotics brand of Shenzhen Jilian Technology. Its Agile component portfolio spans miniature harmonic actuators, quasi-direct-drive planetary joints and heavier cycloidal joints for dexterous end effectors, wheeled-legged platforms, quadrupeds and humanoid robots. Its website also offers physical-AI software platforms and lists Siemens industrial-control products separately.
